purpose: Provide a leakage-resistant chronological benchmark before accepting richer predictive or recovery models.
required_data: at least three ordered observations per eligible entity

primary_sources.citation: Bruneau et al. (2003), A Framework to Quantitatively Assess and Enhance the Seismic Resilience of Communities

known_limitations: The base prediction is the final training observation.
The holdout is never shuffled into training.
Within-project benchmarking is not external validation.
